claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Rizatriptan is a triptan with no cytotoxic mechanism at 2.5 uM; its only reported non-receptor activity is weak aquaporin-4 inhibition (IC50 ~2 uM), which is not expected to kill cancer cells, so it should be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen.
